description: Watch something and tell the workspace's owners and admins when it happens. Subjects: issues (the whole error stream: new_issue, regression, spike, occurrences, users_affected), issue (one issue: regression, spike, occurrences, users_affected), panel (a board panel from get_board: threshold, change), board (every panel on a board: change), event (one event's count or unique users, no panel needed: threshold, change; "below 1 per hour" means it stopped arriving). The issues and event subjects watch the projects in `projects` (every project this connection reaches when left out); the others follow the issue, panel or board they name. For a fix, use watch_issue. You cannot give a watch a webhook, a Slack URL or an email list: sending a workspace's data somewhere new is a person's decision, and a person adds destinations in Vinktar. Only create a watch when the user asked for one.

aggregation.description: subject event: count every event (default) or the people doing it.

boardId.description: subject board: the board, from list_boards.

condition.description: What counts as news: new_issue, regression, spike (against the 7-day baseline), occurrences (more than spikeMinCount in spikeWindowMinutes), users_affected (more than spikeMinCount distinct users in spikeWindowMinutes) for error subjects; threshold (crosses a line), change (moves by a percentage against the window before).

direction.description: threshold: above (default) or below the line. change: up, down or either (default).

environment.description: Error subjects: only this environment, e.g. "production". Omit for all.

event.description: subject event: the event name, from get_schema.

issueId.description: The issue id (from list_issues) or its Vinktar URL, as a person would paste it.

minLevel.description: Error subjects: the least severe level that counts.

name.description: What it watches, as a person would say it: "Signups dropping", "New issues in production".

panelId.description: subject panel: the panel, from get_board.

percent.description: change only: how far it has to move, in percent. Default 50.

project.description: Project handle (as in list_projects) or id. Optional when this connection is limited to one project or the workspace has only one.

projects.description: Project handles (as in list_projects) or ids, to read across several apps. Leave out for every project this connection can reach. For one project use `project`; never pass both.

spikeMinCount.description: spike: a floor, so a quiet issue going from 1 to 4 is not a spike (default 50). occurrences, users_affected: the line (default 100).

spikeMultiplier.description: spike only: how many times the baseline counts as a spike. Default 3.

spikeWindowMinutes.description: spike, occurrences, users_affected: the window in minutes. Default 10 for spike, 60 otherwise.

window.description: threshold and change: the trailing window the value is computed over. Default "hour".
